subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery files before merge, or is immediate deletion an intentional accepted upgrade break?
rationale: Config backups may be the user's only recovery copy, and the repository policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive rather than an automation-only choice.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files in the bounded retention set or convert them into timestamped backups before pruning.

options.title: Keep The Numbered Ring
options.body: Reject the timestamped naming change for now and keep the shipped numbered recovery contract intact.

options.title: Accept Timestamp-Only Cleanup
options.body: Allow the first upgraded config write to prune existing numbered backups, accepting the recovery-point loss as a deliberate product tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files in the bounded retention set or convert them into timestamped backups before pruning.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history on the backup rotation helper and config recovery semantics touched by this migration choice.
